comments.author: gord1306
comments.body: Is any duplicate add topology job running at the same time? maybe the ethxx_t interfaces conflict or the previous jobs not remove topology?

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: no, i do not see that. ddd8c3eth31_t@inj-vms6-1-31 is an intermediate results during adding the injected ports, therefore I suspect something crashed and left the system in such state. I think the issue here is that vm topology script is not able to recover the system from that bad state.

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: @gord1306 , is this something you can help?

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: looks like I found the reason, it is because of this pr. https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/2459
